assertion: Without store readOnlyHint true, replay warning, repeated payment remains paid/single_use false

evidence.description: Did transaction `txid` pay the merchant at least `amount_zat` zatoshis with memo `memo`, with at least `min_conf` confirmations and no transparent part? Checked live on Zcash testnet with the merchant’s incoming viewing key. Returns ok, verdict (paid, refused, or unverified when ZPV_LWD_URLS lists several lightwalletd endpoints and they disagree or too few answer), reasons (TX_NOT_FOUND, NO_OUTPUT_TO_KEY, MEMO_MISMATCH, AMOUNT_TOO_LOW, NOT_CONFIRMED, TRANSPARENT_PART, UNVERIFIED_DISAGREEMENT, UNVERIFIED_QUORUM, ALREADY_USED) and what the key saw. Replay: unless the server runs with ZPV_STORE (single_use true in the answer), a check does not mark a payment as used: the same txid passes every time it is asked, and without a memo any past payment to the merchant passes, so record the txids you accepted and always pass the invoice memo. With ZPV_STORE each payment is accepted once and a second check answers ALREADY_USED. min_conf cannot go below the server’s floor (ZPV_MCP_MIN_CONF, default 1).
